about_the_game:
Waking up on ‘Aquatica,’ a crash-landed ARK submerged within a vast underwater biome system, survivors are thrust into exotic challenges never before encountered: extreme environmental hazards, crushing pressures, rapid currents, and a host of extraordinary creatures await within the mysterious depths. On Aquatica, survivors will uncover the potential source of Element and catch a glimpse of what the future holds for those bold enough to endure. Aquatica is the first official DLC to tell a non-canonical mythical story, expanding the ARK universe into new dimensions of survival.

Game Features:

Aquatica is the special 10-year anniversary DLC for ARK: Survival Evolved, initially releasing on PC.

  • Fully Underwater Gameplay Experience: Explore a completely submerged ARK, introducing new mechanics and survival challenges.

  • Family-Friendly Starting Biome: Begin your adventure in a more approachable biome designed for players of all ages.

  • Reimagined ARK Universe: Experience a fresh perspective on the ARK world, pushing the boundaries of lore and exploration.

  • Exclusive ASE Official Server Support: Limited-time support for official servers, enhancing the multiplayer experience.

AN ARK CRASH-LANDED

Aquatica places survivors on a damaged ARK that has crash-landed deep within the Atlantic Ocean, predating the events of Extinction. The ARK’s systems failed to purge corruption upon impact, resulting in a fully flooded environment. Unnatural rifts caused by Pure Element have destabilized the surrounding Corrupted Element, leading to extreme transformations. Influenced by the Element itself, the ARK has evolved into a breathtaking, perilous new world to explore.

TAME NEW CREATURES

Capture and tame 17 new creatures with extraordinary abilities! Traverse the depths on the mystical Monodon, fend off hostile threats with the protective Mudpuppy, and encounter mutated variants of familiar dinos, reimagined for life beneath the waves.

CRAFT UNIQUE AND REIMAGINED ITEMS

With 60 new Engrams, survivors gain access to gear designed for underwater survival. Utilize Lead Boots to walk along the ocean floor, adapt land-dwelling creatures with mutations for underwater breathing, and construct innovative TEK Air Pockets for submerged bases. Additionally, discover 10 new cooking recipes tailored to the aquatic ecosystem.

CONQUER NEW CHALLENGES

Survive in a fully submerged ARK, its malfunctioning systems transforming the environment into a vast, aquatic labyrinth. Navigate five expansive biomes, each with unique threats and breathtaking landscapes, while mastering the complexities of underwater survival.

AN INTRIGUING STORYLINE

Prepare to face the terrifying forces lurking in the abyss as you unravel the origin story of Element. Encounter two brand new characters and immerse yourself in a narrative that bridges multiple ARKs, expanding the lore of ARK: Survival Evolved like never before.

content_descriptors.notes: Mature Content, specifically violence, can occur against other players or creatures within the fantasy setting of our game at any time and is not gated. This would primarily be demonstrated when players use their fists, melee weapons, ranged weapons, or tamed creatures against other players and/or other creatures. Violence may also be demonstrated when wild npc creatures choose to attack player characters and/or other wild or tamed creatures within the game world. Depictions of and reactions to violence (by targeted player character or creature) are not realistically portrayed and the level of blood associated with these acts is mild and limited.
